Item 1. Business

Acme Widgets Inc. designs and sells industrial widgets to manufacturers.

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

Our business is subject to numerous risks, and investors should carefully consider the risks described below together with the other information in this report.

We depend on two contract manufacturers located in different regions, and any disruption at either facility could delay widget shipments to our customers.

Our revenue is concentrated among a small number of large customers, and the loss of any one of them could materially reduce our net sales and results of operations.

Changes in tariffs and trade policy between the United States and China could increase our component costs and reduce our gross margin in future periods.

Our indebtedness under the revolving credit facility contains restrictive covenants that limit our operating flexibility and could accelerate repayment if breached.

The market price of our common stock has been volatile and may continue to fluctuate significantly regardless of our operating performance.

We rely on third-party software and information technology systems, and a cybersecurity incident could disrupt operations and expose us to liability and reputational harm.

Our ability to protect our intellectual property is limited, and competitors may develop similar widget designs that erode our market share and pricing.

Environmental, health and safety regulations applicable to our manufacturing processes could impose significant compliance costs and potential liabilities on the Company.

We may pursue acquisitions that involve integration risks, diversion of management attention, and the possibility that expected synergies are not realized.

Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates could adversely affect our reported revenue because a significant portion of our sales are denominated in euros.

Our success depends on retaining key executives and engineers, and the loss of their services could harm our product development roadmap.

We are the subject of a pending Department of Justice investigation relating to export controls, and an adverse outcome could result in substantial fines and restrictions.
